# Observation of Squeezed States Generated by Four-Wave Mixing in an Optical Cavity

Slusher and collaborators report electromagnetic squeezed states produced by four-wave mixing with sodium atoms in an optical cavity. Balanced homodyne detection measures amplification of one field quadrature and deamplification of the other, with the latter's noise below the vacuum reference level.

- Authors: R. E. Slusher, L. W. Hollberg, B. Yurke, J. C. Mertz, and J. F. Valley.
- Published: *Physical Review Letters* **55** (1985), 2409--2412.
- DOI and primary abstract: [10.1103/PhysRevLett.55.2409](https://journals.aps.org/prl/abstract/10.1103/PhysRevLett.55.2409).
- Erratum: *Physical Review Letters* **56**, 788 (1986), [publisher record](https://doi.org/10.1103/PhysRevLett.56.788).
- Access: publisher metadata and original abstract inspected 2026-09-04; erratum text not inspected.
- Local artifacts: none.
